verdict.rationale: LibreOffice's own repo points developers to an official SDK with API docs and a Developers Guide (gh-1). Its docs describe a headless mode and UNO acceptor so external clients can control it through the API (docs-2, docs-3). A community user also mentions Python APIs, though with a poor experience (comm-12), and another could not find a JavaScript API for Calc (comm-14), so coverage of mainstream languages is thin and unclear. missing for 10: documented list of officially supported language bindings, evidence of versioned client library releases, evidence of vendor maintenance cadence, independent corroboration of a good developer experience.
